say:2:1630127001:1.text: Every human who comes here ends up talking to rocks. It's the strangest thing!
say:2:1630127001:1.source_cn: 来这里的人类都有个怪癖，他们最喜欢跟石头聊天了！
say:2:1630127001:1.male: Every human who comes here ends up talking to rocks. It's the strangest thing!
say:2:1630127001:1.female: Every human who comes here ends up talking to rocks. It's the strangest thing!

say:3:1630127002:1.text: I literally stand on the rock, answering their questions on its behalf. Do they listen? No. Some of them even start slinging spells at me!
say:3:1630127002:1.source_cn: 明明我就站在石头上替石头回答他们，他们却不理我，有的还...
say:3:1630127002:1.male: I literally stand on the rock, answering their questions on its behalf. Do they listen? No. Some of them even start slinging spells at me!
say:3:1630127002:1.female: I literally stand on the rock, answering their questions on its behalf. Do they listen? No. Some of them even start slinging spells at me!

say:4:1630127003:1.text: Rude. I'm offering free wisdom and all I get is lightning to the beak. Caw!
say:4:1630127003:1.source_cn: 真是太不识好鸟心了！嘎！
say:4:1630127003:1.male: Rude. I'm offering free wisdom and all I get is lightning to the beak. Caw!
say:4:1630127003:1.female: Rude. I'm offering free wisdom and all I get is lightning to the beak. Caw!
